ui.agents.navigation.updates.preview.emp.length_hint: One wrapped status line above the diff area
ui.agents.navigation.updates.preview.emp.note: The dry-run comparison found no differing regions; no selection is needed.

ui.agents.navigation.updates.preview.loc.role: Heading above local text in comparison
ui.agents.navigation.updates.preview.loc.note: Labels the person’s current local wording, not the hub version.

ui.agents.navigation.updates.preview.rem.role: Heading above hub text in comparison
ui.agents.navigation.updates.preview.rem.note: Labels incoming wording from the hub, not the local wording.

ui.agents.navigation.updates.accessible.role: Accessible name of hub-update status section
ui.agents.navigation.updates.accessible.tone: Name the section rather than its action
ui.agents.navigation.updates.accessible.length_hint: Screen-reader label; no visible width limit
ui.agents.navigation.updates.accessible.note: Shared by the current update panel and the residual action-result section.

ui.agents.navigation.updates.baseline_un.role: Warning guidance before unknown-baseline merge choice
ui.agents.navigation.updates.baseline_un.tone: Explain what both actions retain, without recommending one
ui.agents.navigation.updates.baseline_un.note: No saved baseline exists. Both choices add hub additions and delete nothing local; preference decides only conflicting wording.

ui.agents.navigation.updates.merge_guida.note: Nonconflicting parts merge normally; current content is backed up before either choice.

ui.agents.navigation.updates.action.upda.note: An update is already in flight; control remains in its existing busy state.

ui.agents.navigation.updates.action.upda.role: Button applying an available hub update
ui.agents.navigation.updates.action.upda.length_hint: Small update action button, about 19 English characters
ui.agents.navigation.updates.action.upda.note: Applies an update eligible for the existing nondecision path; not a destructive replacement.

ui.agents.navigation.updates.action.retr.note: Retry is running; does not represent a successful update.

ui.agents.navigation.updates.action.retr.role: Button retrying a retryable hub failure
ui.agents.navigation.updates.action.retr.note: Shown only when the failure is classified retryable.

ui.agents.navigation.updates.action.load.role: Preview button label during first preview request
ui.agents.navigation.updates.action.load.note: Loading refers to dry-run differences, not installing an agent.

ui.agents.navigation.updates.action.prev.role: Button fetching a dry-run difference preview
ui.agents.navigation.updates.action.prev.length_hint: Small outline action button; may be wider than Retry
ui.agents.navigation.updates.action.prev.note: Runs a dry-run apply without choosing which wording to keep.

ui.agents.navigation.updates.action.keep.tone: Explicit choice consequences, not blanket replacement
ui.agents.navigation.updates.action.keep.length_hint: Small ghost action button; about 26 English characters
ui.agents.navigation.updates.action.keep.note: Only where the two versions differ, keep local wording. Other regions merge normally.

ui.agents.navigation.updates.action.use_.tone: Explicit choice consequences; no promotional emphasis
ui.agents.navigation.updates.action.use_.length_hint: Small ghost action button; about 30 English characters
ui.agents.navigation.updates.action.use_.note: Only differing regions use incoming hub wording; it is not whole-document replace.

ui.agents.navigation.sidebar.options.note: Opens options for this agent without selecting its row.

ui.agents.navigation.sidebar.title.note: Names the local agent list, not the public hub.

ui.agents.navigation.sidebar.loading.note: The local agent list request is pending.

ui.agents.navigation.sidebar.error.length_hint: Short wrapped alert in the sidebar
ui.agents.navigation.sidebar.error.note: Shown after the list request fails, not when a search has no results.

ui.agents.navigation.sidebar.retry.note: Refetches the failed local list request.

ui.agents.navigation.sidebar.search_empt.role: No-results state for filtered local agent list
ui.agents.navigation.sidebar.search_empt.note: A search term exists but no local agents match; not evidence that none are installed.

ui.agents.navigation.sidebar.empty.role: No-agents state for unfiltered local list
ui.agents.navigation.sidebar.empty.note: No search is active and the local list is empty.

ui.agents.navigation.legacy.title.note: Names the old management surface, not the hub catalogue.

ui.agents.navigation.legacy.more_actions.role: Accessible name of compact agent-actions menu button
ui.agents.navigation.legacy.more_actions.note: In compact layout this menu contains export and hub upload actions.

ui.agents.navigation.legacy.export.role: Export action in menu and full-width header button
ui.agents.navigation.legacy.export.length_hint: Short button/menu item, about 6 English characters
ui.agents.navigation.legacy.export.note: Downloads the selected agent archive; it does not publish the agent.

ui.agents.navigation.legacy.upload.role: Publication action in menu and header button
ui.agents.navigation.legacy.upload.length_hint: Menu item or button, about 13 English characters
ui.agents.navigation.legacy.upload.note: Opens the publication dialog for the selected agent; not a local ZIP import.

ui.agents.navigation.legacy.chat.role: Button starting a chat with selected agent
ui.agents.navigation.legacy.chat.note: Creates a draft conversation using this agent; backend agent identity is unchanged.

ui.agents.navigation.updates.preview.not.role: Empty local or hub diff-region marker
ui.agents.navigation.updates.preview.not.note: Shown when a comparison region contains no text. Parentheses distinguish it from authored content.

ui.agents.navigation.sidebar.no_descript.tone: Quiet metadata absence, not an error
ui.agents.navigation.sidebar.no_descript.length_hint: Truncated second line of a row and its hover tooltip
ui.agents.navigation.sidebar.no_descript.note: Only shown when author-provided description is empty; descriptions themselves are not translated.

ui.agents.navigation.sidebar.import_hint.note: Imports an agent from a ZIP file; keep ZIP as the format name.

ui.agents.navigation.legacy.subtitle.length_hint: One header subtitle line; wraps if necessary
ui.agents.navigation.legacy.subtitle.note: Explains viewing and configuring local agents.

ui.agents.navigation.legacy.unnamed_agen.note: Used only when the selected agent has no display name; not an actual agent identifier.

ui.agents.navigation.legacy.chat_named.length_hint: One short tooltip line plus the agent display name
ui.agents.navigation.legacy.chat_named.note: The visible button says Chat; the tooltip identifies its recipient.

placeholders.name: Selected agent display name unchanged, or localized legacy.unnamed_agent if missing; never translate real agent names.
